index.title: ARC Starter Templates — One-click site demos for WordPress

hero.title: Effortless Website Creation<br class="hidden sm:block" /> Starts Here.
hero.lead: ARC Starter Templates imports complete Tailwind sites into WordPress in one click — Elementor-editable or Gutenberg blocks, images in your Media Library, menus and front page wired automatically.

index.intro: Pick a demo, run the step-by-step wizard and get a full site — pages, images, menus and settings — in under a minute. The plugin stays lightweight: template documents and images live in this repository and download on demand at import time.

demos.title: {count} Free Templates for All Purposes.
demos.lead: Corporate, e-commerce, blog, nonprofit and more — each design is a complete multi-page site, tailored for one-click import.

features.title: Key Features.
features.lead: Everything a starter-template plugin should do — and nothing it shouldn't.

items.title: One-click import wizard
items.text: Step-by-step Media → Pages → Setup flow with live progress, per-page selection, dry-run and optional reset.

items.title: Elementor or Gutenberg
items.text: With Elementor pages import as native container/widget layouts; without it they land as editable block pages.

items.title: Remote payload
items.text: Manifest, documents and images live in this repo — the plugin stays light and every import pulls the latest state.

items.title: Media Library images
items.text: Every image downloads into your Media Library on import and template URLs are rewritten to it.

items.title: Menus & front page
items.text: Home is set as the front page and the demo's Main + Footer menus are assigned to the theme locations.

items.title: Working contact form
items.text: Configurable recipient, honeypot, consent checkbox and a Form Entries panel storing every submission.

items.title: Block patterns
items.text: Every imported page is also registered under the ARC Starter Templates pattern category.

items.title: WP-CLI ready
items.text: wp arc-st import, reset and status — provision headless sites from the command line.

setup.title: Connect the plugin to this repo.
setup.lead: wp-admin → ARC Templates → Templates repository → Remote base URL. This repo is public — leave the access token empty and every import pulls the latest state.

steps.title: Install & activate
steps.text: Copy the plugin to wp-content/plugins and activate ARC Starter Templates.

steps.title: Paste the remote URL
steps.text: ARC Templates → Templates repository → Remote base URL.

steps.title: Import a demo
steps.text: Open the library, click a card and run the wizard — done in under a minute.

cta.title: Experience the power of one-click starter sites.
cta.text: Activate ARC Starter Templates, point it at this repository and import your first demo today.
